en.headline: Tai Po water supply restored after overnight main repair
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said supply to Tai Yuen Estate, Ting Nga Court and Tai Yuen Shopping Centre began returning to normal from about 6 a.m. after crews finished emergency works on On Po Road.
body: The Water Supplies Department said fresh-water supply to Tai Yuen Estate, Ting Nga Court and Tai Yuen Shopping Centre in Tai Po began returning to normal from about 6 a.m. on Thursday after overnight emergency repairs to a burst main on On Po Road.

A 200-millimetre fresh-water pipe near Tai Yuen Estate ruptured on Wednesday afternoon, flooding the carriageway and disrupting supply to several nearby estates. The department earlier said about 5,000 households could be affected and scheduled a shutdown after 11 p.m. so crews could work after the evening peak.

The department said two water trucks and 20 water tanks had been placed near the affected blocks, and a dedicated team delivered bottled water to households and residential care homes that needed it. It had aimed to finish the repair by noon on Thursday unless weather or unexpected site problems intervened.
Residents who still find no water or unusually discoloured taps were advised to contact their estate management office or the department’s hotline.

zh.headline: 大埔安埔路水管搶修完成 大元邸汀雅苑今早復水
zh.dek: 水務署表示通宵完成緊急維修，大元邸、汀雅苑及大元商場食水供應由今早約6時起陸續恢復正常。
body: 水務署表示，大埔安埔路一條爆裂食水管經工程人員通宵搶修後，大元邸、汀雅苑及大元商場的食水供應已於今日早上約6時開始陸續恢復正常。
周三下午安埔路近大元邸一條直徑200毫米食水供水管爆裂，路面一度水浸，大元邸、汀雅苑及附近商場食水受影響，署方早前估計近5,000戶受影響，並安排晚上11時用水高峰後才停水維修。
署方已在受影響範圍附近放置兩輛水車及20個水箱，並派出供水特攻隊為有需要住戶及安老院送上樽裝水。除非工程遇上特別困難，署方原先爭取今日中午12時前完成搶修。
若個別單位仍未有水或水質異常，水務署呼籲居民聯絡屋苑管理處或該署熱線。
